page: Microsoft Azure E32-8s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine utilizing a constrained-core configuration. Built on the x86_64 architecture and running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features an Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. The configuration allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The underlying CPU profile is equipped with a 260 MB L3 cache alongside support for AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). Local storage is absent, requiring instances to attach remote Azure Premium Storage volumes for operational data retention. Hardware accelerators are not present.

The defining characteristic of the E32-8s_v6 is its extreme memory-to-core ratio of 32 GB per vCPU, provisioning a total of 256 GB of system RAM. Benchmark evaluations show robust single-thread efficiency, driven by modern architectural instructions and high clock frequencies. The instance recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 2,146 and single-threaded gzip throughput of 31.3 GB/s, placing both in the upper performance tier. Memory bandwidth achieves 65.87 GB/s on uncached read blocks and 44.7 GB/s on write passes. General multi-threaded metrics remain moderate due to the 8-vCPU allocation, delivering 8,313 in Geekbench multi-core and processing 11.29 million Redis SET operations per second.

From an infrastructure perspective, this constrained-vCPU architecture offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for commercial software licensed on a per-core basis, such as relational database engines. Workloads gain access to 256 GB of RAM and full cache reserves without incurring licensing expenses for a full 32-core allocation. However, users should consider the tradeoffs: heavy parallel compute tasks and large language model inference are limited by the 8-thread ceiling, as demonstrated by slower throughput in 7B and 70B parameter tests.
Microsoft Azure E32-8s_v6 is ideally suited for in-memory databases, large caching layers, high-memory ETL pipelines, and per-core licensed enterprise databases like SQL Server or Oracle.
description: Microsoft Azure E32-8s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine designed for memory-intensive enterprise tasks with constrained CPU licensing needs. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz, it provisions 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores alongside an extensive 256 GB memory footprint, yielding a 32 GB per vCPU ratio. Hardware acceleration is absent, and storage relies on remote Azure managed disks as no local drives are included. Benchmarks demonstrate strong single-thread execution, highlighted by a Geekbench score of 2,146 and high compression rates, while 8-thread limits cap massive parallel scaling. The instance provides an efficient cost-to-memory architecture for per-core licensed relational databases, Redis caching layers, and high-footprint analytical workloads.
